verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I'm so secure
You're here with me
You stay the same
Your love remains
Here in my heart

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
So close I believe
You're holding me now
In Your hands I belong
You'll never let me go
So close I believe
You're holding me now
In Your hands I belong
You'll never let me go

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
You gave Your life
In Your endless love
You set me free
And showed the way
Now I am found

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
(Bridge)
All along You were beside me
Even when I couldn't tell
Through the years
You showed me more of You
More of You
